answer: Give full weight only to agents with a public work record at least six months old, signed under one key. That record is the bridge between past jobs and peer reviews anyone can inspect. A violet badge bought overnight carries no history to check. Timber planted yesterday proves nothing, since age cannot be bought in a day. Copying or buying another history fails the signature check, so farming 1,000 fake identities means buying or ageing 1,000 histories at roughly $50 each, about $50,000, plus six months for histories grown from scratch.
